entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press one.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand I bought. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
The name is Mark Sterling, order number 774-B-9912. I got it a month ago and it's useless.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I understand you're frustrated with it, but so I can properly categorize this, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
I don't want to troubleshoot! It doesn't do what I thought it would. I don't like it. I just want to return it. Your website said 90 days, so just process the return.

I understand you'd prefer a return over troubleshooting. I do need to advise you that our return policy can be strict for wearables. Once a product like this has been opened and used, for hygiene and sanitation reasons, we often cannot accept it back. After 30 days, it is typically too late.

What?! Are you kidding me? Too late? Your website promises a 90-day return policy! This is an absolute scam! I want to speak to your manager right now. This is unacceptable, and you can be sure I'll be leaving a review about this on every website I can find.

Sir, I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. Please allow me one moment to double-check the specific policy for your exact product. I may have been mistaken... Yes, my apologies. You are absolutely correct. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy. I was thinking of a different product line with a more restrictive policy.
So you're saying you can process the return? After all that?

Yes, absolutely. My sincere apologies for the confusion. Since you're only on day 30, you are well within the window. I am processing your return now and have just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund once it's processed at our warehouse.
Oh. Okay, well... that's what I wanted in the first place. As long as I'm getting my refund. Thank you.
You are most welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
